notices.title: [합성] Customs documentation for imported battery cell production equipment
notices.content: [합성] From 2026-03-01, customs release of battery cell production equipment imported from outside the EU requires additional environmental due-diligence documentation. Authorities may take up to 30 days to review the documentation after submission.

notices.title: [합성] Battery regulation: due-diligence documentation for imported cell production equipment
notices.content: [합성] From 2026-11-01, operators installing battery cell production equipment imported from outside the EU must submit additional environmental due-diligence documentation before site installation and commissioning. Competent authorities may take up to 30 days to review. Transitional arrangements are not yet confirmed.

notices.title: [합성] Local regulatory approval backlog in Hungary
notices.content: [합성] 헝가리 지방정부 인허가 접수분의 처리 기간이 2025-10-01부터 최대 45일 늘어날 수 있습니다. Local regulatory approval backlog.
